stories.title: Nvidia stock plunges 14%, wraps up longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis
stories.summary: Once the most valuable company in the world, Nvidia now ranks fourth behind Apple, Microsoft and Alphabet.
stories.zh_title: 英偉達股價暴跌14%，結束自2008年金融危機以來最長的單週下跌
stories.zh_summary: 英偉達曾經是世界上最有價值的公司，現在排名第四，僅次於蘋果、微軟和 Alphabet。

stories.title: Dow, S&P 500 enter correction as Nasdaq suffers worst week since 2020
stories.summary: All 11 S&P 500 sectors finished more than 1% lower this week for the first time since April 2025.
stories.zh_title: 道瓊斯指數和標準普爾 500 指數進入回調，納斯達克指數遭遇 2020 年以來最糟糕的一周
stories.zh_summary: 標普 500 指數所有 11 個板塊本週收盤均下跌超過 1%，這是自 2025 年 4 月以來首次。

stories.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
stories.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics's most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world's best mathematicians for decades. If verified, it would mark yet another seismic achievement for AI in mathematics and add to the upheaval […]
stories.zh_title: 人擇數學家聲稱已經與克勞德解決了久負盛名的千禧年獎問題
stories.zh_summary: 人擇數學家萊文特·阿爾波格 (Levent Alpöge) 聲稱，他在克勞德的幫助下證明了黎曼猜想，這是數學中最臭名昭著的難題之一，破解了數十年來世界上一些最優秀數學家一直未能解決的難題。如果得到證實，這將標誌著另一場地震

stories.title: Anthropic raises $93.5 billion total as underwriters scoop up ‘greenshoe’ overallotment
stories.summary: The AI company sold an aggregate of 1,127,000,000 shares at $83 per share in the record IPO.
stories.zh_title: 承銷商獲得「綠鞋」超額配售，Anthropic 融資總額達 935 億美元
stories.zh_summary: 這家人工智慧公司在創紀錄的 IPO 中以每股 83 美元的價格總共出售了 1,127,000,000 股股票。

stories.title: These stocks were crushed the most this week as the tech wreck accelerated
stories.summary: 94% of stocks in the S&P 500 declined for the week, 11 of them by at least 20%. But for now, analysts still think you can make a lot of money if you buy them.
stories.zh_title: 隨著科技災難加速，這些股票本週跌幅最大
stories.zh_summary: 標普 500 指數中有 94% 的股票本週下跌，其中 11 隻下跌至少 20%。但就目前而言，分析師仍然認為，如果你購買它們，你可以賺很多錢。

stories.title: Google rolls out new search homepage with AI chat history and no search button
stories.summary: Google search is making it even easier to access AI tools on the search page.
stories.zh_title: 谷歌推出新的搜尋主頁，帶有人工智慧聊天記錄，沒有搜尋按鈕
stories.zh_summary: 谷歌搜尋讓在搜尋頁面上存取人工智慧工具變得更加容易。

stories.title: Nvidia’s stock clinches a stretch of weekly losses not seen since 2008
stories.summary: One fund manager says the continued uncertainty makes Nvidia vulnerable to more selling, even as the stock has erased $1.16 trillion in market value in the past seven trading sessions.
stories.zh_title: 英偉達股價錄得 2008 年以來未見的周跌幅
stories.zh_summary: 一位基金經理人表示，持續的不確定性使英偉達容易遭受更多拋售，儘管該股在過去七個交易日中市值蒸發了 1.16 兆美元。

stories.title: Meta reconsiders 2030 net-zero goal amid record emissions from AI data centers
stories.summary: Meta is “re-evaluating” 2030 sustainability goals. Will others follow?
stories.zh_title: 在 AI 資料中心排放創紀錄之際，Meta 重新思考 2030 年淨零排放目標
stories.zh_summary: Meta 正在「重新評估」2030 年永續發展目標。其他人會效法嗎？

stories.title: Anthropic defied the odds in its record IPO. Now it has to reckon with AI market turbulence
stories.summary: Anthropic faced a market sell-off, raging anti-AI sentiment and a crisis at Nvidia in pulling off the largest IPO on record.
stories.zh_title: Anthropic 克服困难，实现了创纪录的 IPO。現在它必須應對人工智慧市場的動盪
stories.zh_summary: Anthropic 面臨市場拋售、強烈的反人工智慧情緒以及英偉達在完成有史以來最大的 IPO 方面面臨的危機。

stories.title: Prediction markets outlook for stocks in 2026 dims amid AI sell-off
stories.summary: Odds that the S&P 500 will cross 8,000, which were once north of 70%, are extremely low on platform Kalshi.
stories.zh_title: 由於人工智慧拋售，市場預測 2026 年股票前景黯淡
stories.zh_summary: 在 Kalshi 平台上，標普 500 指數突破 8,000 點的可能性（曾經超過 70%）非常低。

stories.title: Daniel Ek backs AI researcher’s fusion power startup. Here’s what they’re building.
stories.summary: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is backing Europa Fusion, a fusion power startup founded by an AI researcher. Here's what the startup is building.
stories.zh_title: Daniel Ek 支援人工智慧研究人員的聚變能源新創公司。這就是他們正在建造的東西。
stories.zh_summary: Spotify 創辦人 Daniel Ek 正在支援 Europa Fusion，這是一家由人工智慧研究員創立的聚變能源新創公司。這就是這家新創公司正在開發的產品。

stories.title: The bull market has a new problem. The 'smart money' is selling
stories.summary: Companies are shifting from share buybacks to stock issuance, adding new supply. Anthropic’s $81 billion IPO puts that demand to the test.
stories.zh_title: 牛市又出現了新問題。 「聰明錢」正在拋售
stories.zh_summary: 公司正在從股票回購轉向股票發行，增加新的供應。 Anthropic 810 億美元的 IPO 考驗了這項需求。

stories.title: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen
stories.summary: Signal is restricting the ability to take screenshots on Android and iOS devices in an effort to prevent AI agents from reading users' messages and other data. The agentic AI capabilities built into operating systems that analyze on-screen information to learn more about the user are "undermining Signal's ability to independently guarantee privacy," Signal president […]
stories.zh_title: Signal 阻止 Gemini 和 Siri AI 讀取您的螢幕
stories.zh_summary: Signal 正在限制 Android 和 iOS 设备上截取屏幕截图的能力，以防止 AI 代理读取用户的消息和其他数据。作業系統中內建的代理人工智慧功能可以分析螢幕上的信息以了解有關用戶的更多信息，這些功能正在“破壞系統”

stories.title: Muse Is Unleashing a World of Pettiness on Instagram
stories.summary: Meta’s AI assistant can track and unfollow Instagram users who don’t follow you back—and some people are taking full advantage.
stories.zh_title: Muse 在 Instagram 上釋放小資世界
stories.zh_summary: Meta 的人工智慧助理可以追蹤和取消關注那些不關注你的 Instagram 用戶——有些人正在充分利用這一優勢。

stories.title: Tech wreck drags Anthropic into the red on its second day of trading
stories.summary: Nasdaq futures trade lower after steep declines extend across global tech stocks
stories.zh_title: 科技股重挫，導致 Anthropic 在上市交易的第二天就陷入虧損。
stories.zh_summary: 全球科技股大幅下跌後納斯達剋期貨交易走低
